license.name: Privacy Partitions
license.registry: Connecticut DCP State Licenses and Credentials (official open data, data.ct.gov dataset ngch-56tr) and CT Business Registry Business Master (data.ct.gov n7gp-d28j); no Long Island commercial registry applies
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Connecticut has no state license for commercial partition installation (repo research/state-licensing/states.json, CT: Major Contractor registration only for threshold buildings, HIC registration residential only). For the long-island area, the Nassau and Suffolk county licenses cover home improvement (residential) work; commercial permits come from the individual town or village (repo research/local-rules/cities.json, low confidence, phone-call item), so there is no online registry to check for commercial work. Searches of the official CT license data (name, business name and DBA containing 'PRIVACY', and West Haven names with PARTITION/TOILET/BATH) found no record for Privacy Partitions: no CT Home Improvement Contractor registration under that name. The CT business registry open data also has no entity named 'Privacy Partitions'; the brand may trade under another legal name, which the company site (privacypartitionsne.com) does not state. If they do residential jobs in CT or on Long Island, a CT HIC registration or Nassau/Suffolk home improvement license would be needed; ask for their legal entity name and any HIC number.
